text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.

Check #4419 before it goes into the weekly notes. Marcus Lindqvist's Q2 expansion note also cites #4419, but describes it as Gate 3 printer lag. These may be two different issues sharing a number.

The other QFL digests (Sept 14 pipeline, Mar 23 renewals) mention the account without a ticket number. The #4409 and #4412 tickets in the Central handoffs digest concern Pree's dealer account, so I left them out.

I can't write to a weekly notes file, so you'll need to paste the list in yourself.
